set.body:
Outcome

Prove that the relational evidence model supports first-order scientific closure without pretending it is classification or RSA.

Acceptance

- Contrast queries bind to an exact effect axis and estimability capability.
- Partition reduction and any sampling claim are explicit.
- Measurement-frame execution returns a typed effect map with units and provenance.
- Independent small-case and base-R oracle courts pass.
set.title: P5.4: add the first-order contrast and univariate-effect path
